title: Derivatives Margin Workbench
description: Computes event-market linear PnL (settlement vs strike, scalar payoff), margin health (unrealized PnL, buffer, liquidation price, leverage) against a caller-declared venue margin model (regulated-DCM or offshore-perp class, with its own initial/maintenance margin rates rather than an internal per-venue lookup table), and, when a second position is supplied, two-position correlation-VaR cross-margin efficiency (siloed vs shared capital requirement). Closed-form pedagogical approximations of the same computations live risk engines run, not a stress-grid or SPAN-style margin system, and not financial advice.

event_market.description: side, strike, settlement_value, unit_value, n_contracts, min_price, max_price for the linear/scalar event-market payoff.

margin.description: side, entry_price, mark_price, notional, margin_posted, margin_mode (isolated or cross), and venue_margin_model {class, label, imr, mmr} declared by the caller, never looked up by venue name.

cross_margin.description: Optional second position: position_b_notional, position_b_imr, correlation, weight_a, weight_b. Enables the cross-margin efficiency block.

margin.description: unrealized_pnl, margin_balance, maintenance_threshold, buffer, buffer_pct, liquidation_price, leverage_ratio, health (GREEN/AMBER/RED).

cross_margin.description: siloed_margin, shared_margin, efficiency_ratio, capital_saved, benefit (SIGNIFICANT/MODERATE/MINIMAL/NONE). null unless a second position was supplied.

warnings.description: Reader-facing mirror of the raised compliance_flags, one message per flag.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_derivatives_margin_workbench
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes event-market linear PnL, margin health against a caller-declared venue margin model, and two-position correlation-VaR cross-margin efficiency. Use when an agent needs margin buffer, liquidation price, leverage, or cross-margin capital efficiency for a declared derivatives position, without assuming any one venue's margin mechanics.
